profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer | Distributed Systems & Microservices | Java, Kafka, AWS | High-Scale Backend Platforms
profile.summary:
I’m a Staff Software Engineer focused on designing and scaling distributed backend systems that operate under real production load — high-throughput event pipelines, low-latency APIs, and cloud-native architectures on AWS.

Over the past decade I’ve worked across identity platforms, data ingestion systems, and customer-facing services, building microservice ecosystems that process tens of thousands of events per second while maintaining strong observability and operational reliability. My work has delivered measurable impact, including 13x throughput improvements, sub-10ms latency services, and multi-thousand-dollar monthly infrastructure savings through architectural redesign.

I enjoy solving systems problems at scale — service decomposition, event-driven design, performance bottlenecks, and reliability engineering — and collaborating closely with product and platform teams to translate business goals into durable technical solutions.

Core areas of focus:
• Distributed systems architecture
• Event-driven microservices & Kafka pipelines
• Java / Spring Boot backend development
• AWS serverless & containerized infrastructure
• Performance optimization and cost efficiency
• Observability, reliability, and production scalability

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Architect performance optimizations across AWS-based ingestion systems, reducing DynamoDB record size from 72kb to 6kb and eliminating throttling events.
• Increased Kafka processing throughput 13x (300 → 3800 msg/sec) by decomposing tightly coupled services into independently scalable components.
• Designed polling-based GraphQL schema caching strategy removing 800+ reads/sec and reducing monthly infrastructure spend by ~$4K.
• Collaborate with platform and data teams to improve service reliability, scalability, and operational visibility across batch pipelines.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led the design and development of the Universal Customer Profile (UCP), a high-scale Java microservice centralizing aggregated customer data via a dynamically generated GraphQL API. UCP handles over 1,000 requests/sec with sub-10ms latency and is one of the most heavily used services company-wide.
• Architected and implemented a dynamic GraphQL schema builder that auto-updates based on Kafka-streamed attribute metadata. This system ingests machine learning outputs (e.g., offer rankings) to support personalized customer experiences across Experian's digital platforms.
• Engineered and maintained a Kafka-based data pipeline with over 12 topics and 6 brokers, processing up to 60,000 messages/sec. Designed topic/partition strategies and schema validation using AWS Glue and Avro to ensure type safety and parallelism.
• Deployed and managed 7 Java Spring Boot microservices (including two large BFFs) on AWS Fargate, with scaling policies based on load, CPU, and memory usage.
• Reduced public gateway traffic by 800+ req/sec by redesigning inter-service communication pathways to operate more effieciently behind the gateway.
• Drove the end-to-end lifecycle of large-scale service initiatives—from ideation and proof-of-concept to production release—with a strong focus on quality, testability, and observability.
• Spearheaded a proof-of-concept event processing pipeline, integrating updates from 7 distributed services, demonstrating architectural feasibility for organization-wide event handling.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Mentored and led a team of junior and mid-level engineers, while collaborating closely with PMs and engineering managers to align product goals with scalable architecture.
• Designed and implemented a Terraform-based disaster recovery deployment framework across multiple AWS regions.
• Supported infrastructure as code initiatives by building Terraform-based AWS deployments for multiple environments (Dev, Integration, Stage, Prod).
• Analyzed SQL execution plans to design optimal indexing strategies for an enterprise-scale database with tables that contain over 300 million records.
• Optimized stored procedures, achieving up to 90% reduction in response times.
• Developed C#/.NET Core microservices for routing and third-party integration, improving modularity and external service onboarding.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Built a streaming javascript video player with frame accurate scrubing
• Built a video encoding/decoding pipeline using AWS lambdas and step functions
• Created deployment pipelines for AWS micro-services using Jenkins and Octopus Deploy
positions.insights: Skills: ASP.NET MVC · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · C# · C · Gstreamer · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
− Built an API that served newly developed features on the front end of an eCommerce web store. 
− Built a legacy wrapper around the API to serve legacy UI components during the migration from legacy code to new code  
− Built a web crawler in Selenium and Node.JS Puppeteer to capture and record cookies to aid with GDPR compliance

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Migrated business logic from SQL stored procedures into .NET code using Entity Framework
• Supported a team of senior engineers across several production releases
• Developed features for an enterprise .NET application with millions of users
• Increased test coverage across the application by writing extensive unit and integration tests
• Improved the consistency and reliability of the Cornerstone Application through bug fixes and
data fixes
positions.insights: Skills: ASP.NET MVC · Microsoft SQL Server · Entity Framework · C#

positions.title: Intern - Software Engineer (C/C++)
positions.description: Worked with the cable television department to develop software for internet TV devices similar to Apple TV or Roku. Assisted with the development and testing of source code for Broadcom's set-top box application framework.

positions.title: Selenium Automation Engineer
positions.description: Developed regression tests using the Selenium Cucumber Framework. Wrote regression tests in Java.

positions.title: Software Automation Engineer
positions.description:
The Sage 100 product is a complex accounting platform that allows small to medium sized businesses to keep track of their finances.

My job was writing automation software in C# to test successive builds of the Sage 100 product. My software ran on 8 virtual machines running all current versions of Windows. My code was then committed to the company repository. Each automation project was completed in two week sprints using scrum methodology. In addition to the assigned tasks I also created DOS Batch scripts to speed up the testing procedure on the virtual machines. My DOS scripts turned a one hour task into a 5 minute task.

positions.title: QA Engineer
positions.description: Each time Broadcom sells a chip to a customer like Apple or Samsung they are required to submit reports which contain detailed calculations. My job was compiling these reports and ensuring their accuracy. This required enormous attention to detail as there were hundreds of calculations that had to be verified. To ensure nothing was overlooked I created extensive check sheets and custom excel functions. I improved work flow of not only myself but my team by writing a VBA Excel script which automated a 30 minute task and reduced it to a single button click.

projects.title: Class work
projects.description:
C++
•	Used object oriented design methods accompanied by extensive unit testing strategies to implement a simulated file system. 

•	Implemented a simulated resource management and process scheduling system similar to what you would find in an operating system.

* Implemented basic data structures such as linked lists, graphs, binary search trees, ordered maps and priority queues.

* Implemented basic algorithms such as merge sort, quick sort, radix sort, A* search, Dijkstra’s algorithm

Microcontrollers and embedded software

* Wrote software using the Wiring Pi API in the C language to create a home automation device with a Raspberry Pi

Java/Android SDK

* Created a calculator application for Android that graphs a simple algebraic equation

* Created and designed an android game similar to the classic Nintendo title Tetris

* Created and designed an android game where the player controls a mouse character trying to navigate a maze while escaping the cat character

* Wrote scheduling algorithms for the experimental NACHOS operating system

C Programming

* Designed and implemented a graphical user interface for an Optical Character Recognition application on a team

* Designed and implemented movement mechanics in a chess game using the C programming language on a team

* Created an application that performed alterations to image files such as sharpening, mirroring, scaling and edge detection. These functions were then adapted to make the same alterations to the frames of a video file

projects.title: Indoor Autonomous Vehicle
projects.description: A self-navigating robot that is designed to autonomously move around in an unknown environment (indoor), sense and avoid obstacles on its way and can find a specific cubical or office door. The design can be used to deliver mail, documents, or packages within a building.
